articles.title: South Carolina elects Democratic senator for first time in almost three decades
articles.description: Annie Andrews is projected to defeat Darline Graham, who was handpicked by President Trump to take her brother's seat after his death.

articles.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

articles.title: Key moments from a night of midterm election firsts
articles.description: Democrats have taken control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's presidency - proving moments of celebration.

articles.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
articles.description: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

articles.title: US carries out 'limited strikes' on Qeshm Island in Iran
articles.description: The US military has carried out "limited strikes" on Qeshm Island in Iran - hours before the midterms are due to take place.
